capabilities: draw electrical and logic schematics using 72 built-in symbols
define custom IC blocks and reusable circuit snippets
route wires with junctions, named nets and explicit bus lanes
embed live circuit previews inside notes
export diagrams as SVG or PNG
disambiguation: Not a circuit simulator; the author states it is built for schematic drawing and documentation only.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.14.0 or later; supports desktop, tablet and phone with touch gestures, and the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tool for drawing editable electrical and logic schematics that live in the vault next to the notes explaining them.
summary: Schematic editor for drawing electrical and logic circuits with 72 symbols, custom IC blocks, precise wire routing, note embeds and SVG/PNG export.
